piezas.titulo: Speaking practice: Food and simple orders
texto: Integrated conversation: ordering in a Thai restaurant. When the waiter approaches saying «รับอะไรดีคะ/ครับ» (What would you like?), answer confidently, pronouncing clearly «ขอน้ำเปล่าครับ/ค่ะ» or «ขอข้าวกับไก่ครับ/ค่ะ». Practise controlling the low tone of «เผ็ด» and the falling tone of «ข้าว».

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «วัฒนธรรมการแบ่งปันกับข้าวบนโต๊ะสะท้อนถึงน้ำใจและการเอื้อเฟื้อเผื่อแผ่» express?

opciones.texto: Serving shared dishes in the middle of the table reflects social generosity.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «วัฒนธรรมการแบ่งปันกับข้าวบนโต๊ะสะท้อนถึงน้ำใจและการเอื้อเฟื้อเผื่อแผ่» from the text.

opciones.texto: Thai cuisine is famous for its variety of flavours and fresh ingredients.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the text, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: The customer can specify how spicy or sweet they want it, according to their preference.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.

opciones.explicacion: The translation matches the Thai sentence.

opciones.texto: Rice with chicken, please. (common polite phrase with ค่ะ)
opciones.explicacion: This is another sentence on the same topic.

opciones.texto: Not spicy, please. (common polite phrase with ค่ะ)
opciones.explicacion: This sentence expresses a different idea on the same topic.

pregunta.texto: Complete the Thai sentence that expresses «Water, please. (common polite phrase with ครับ)».

opciones.explicacion: Water, please. (common polite phrase with ครับ)

opciones.texto: ขอข้าวกับไก่ค่ะ
opciones.explicacion: The sentence has a different meaning.
